subject: Draft: AWS Marketplace listing + field evidence pack — review & next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: AWS Marketplace listing + field evidence pack — review & next steps

Hi Elaine / AWS Marketplace team,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Attached is our first-pass listing draft and the field evidence binder we plan to publish alongside the product page (short customer stories, benchmark slices, and SOC surface details).

High-level asks:
- AWS team: can you confirm the template requirements for the offer description and which SKU/AMI metadata fields are required for BYO (we plan two SKUs: hosted API and private VPC)?
- Elaine / Nimbus: please validate the customer quote in section 2 of the evidence binder (it references a shared success metric).
- Internal owners (Sean/Kim): review the hero copy and the trial CTA — we want this to be actionable for field sellers.

Attachments: redwood_listing_draft_v1.docx (copy + SKU map), field_evidence_binder_v1.pdf (customer blurbs & benchmark snippets), ami_instructions.txt (AMI tag guidance).

Target timeline: get feedback by EOD Thu (16 Feb) so we can submit the offer for pre-review next week.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace listing + field evidence pack — review & next steps

Hi Irene —

Thanks for sending this through. A few quick items from the marketplace side:
- The offer description should avoid comparative claims (e.g., "cheaper than X") — you can keep the performance numbers but please qualify the benchmark methodology in a short footnote.
- For BYO/AMI workflows we need the SellerID and the AMI inventory mapping in a machine-readable CSV in addition to your ami_instructions.txt.
- Please include a high-res hero image (1200x600) and a short 30-word elevator blurb for catalog search.

We can accept the evidence binder as PDF but will need a list of the pieces included (customer logos with release status) as a separate CSV for our compliance checks.

I'll loop in Procurement (aws-procurement@amazon.com) if you want to surface any pricing parity or discount footnotes early.

Best,
Marketplace Ops (on behalf of Sam R.)
AWS Marketplace
marketplace-ops@amazon.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus.ai>, AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 08:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace listing + field evidence pack — review & next steps

Irene / team — quick copy pass from product marketing:
- Hero headline: changed to "Production-grade LLM inference with predictable cost and latency" (shorter, avoids comparison language).
- Elevator blurb (30 words): "Redwood Inference delivers a unified runtime for low-latency, cost-aware LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Fast onboarding, predictable economics, and observability for production models."
- Trial CTA: recommend "Start a 14-day trial (no card) — includes trial throughput and a sandbox AMI" rather than a generic "Get started".

Two outstanding asks for compliance: customer logos that are "public" vs "private use only" in the evidence binder (we need permission dates). I've marked them inline in the PDF.

Sean
Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Redwood
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 09:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace listing + field evidence pack — review & next steps

Hi Irene / Sean —

Thanks — the quote in section 2 looks fine to us (I confirmed with legal). A couple of notes from Nimbus:
- We can provide a 1-line case study summary and a 2-paragraph reference for the evidence binder; attached is the approved blurb (see inline).
- For co-sell enablement: we need a partner playbook link (one-pager) that outlines the handoff steps (intro > demo > joint MOPs > procurement). I uploaded our playbook here: https://nimbus.ai/partners/redwood-playbook.
- We also need clarity on marketplace SKUs vs co-sell entitlements — if a customer procures via the marketplace, how will revenue attribution work for Nimbus? (high-level answer is fine for the listing).

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync early next week if that helps.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus AI
elaine.park@nimbus.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus.ai>, AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Feb 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace listing + field evidence pack — review & next steps

All, thanks for the fast turn. Quick summary / next steps from our side:
1) I'll produce the machine-readable CSVs (AMI inventory + logo permissions + evidence index) and upload to the Drive link by Mon 19 Feb 11:00 PT.
2) Sean to finalize the 30-word elevator blurb and hero image assets (sean: can you confirm image file by EOD Mon?).
3) Irene to coordinate a short 30-minute sync with Nimbus + AWS Ops for Tue 20 Feb (30 min) — proposed 10:00am PT. Please confirm availability.
4) Legal/compliance: I'll send the evidence index to Compliance for pre-review; if any logos require redaction we'll revert before submission.

Attachments: none in this message — see Drive and the earlier PDF.

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Ops & Launch, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com
